name: Security
description: Global security module: file integrity monitoring, admin IP allowlist, security audit logging, auto-escalation from anti-spam events.
author: Ikabud Kernel Team

event_type.description: The type of security event (login_failed, csrf_blocked, integrity_mismatch, ip_blocked, etc.)

detail.description: Arbitrary detail payload for the event

settings_fields.label: Enable Security Module
settings_fields.description: Master switch for the security module on this tenant.

settings_fields.label: Enable File Integrity Monitoring
settings_fields.description: Track SHA-256 hashes of kernel, module, and configuration files.

settings_fields.label: Monitored Paths (JSON array)
settings_fields.description: JSON array of relative paths to monitor for integrity changes.

settings_fields.label: Enable Admin IP Allowlist
settings_fields.description: Restrict admin route access to allowed IP addresses only. Dormant when the allowlist is empty.

settings_fields.label: Enable Audit Log
settings_fields.description: Log security events (failed logins, CSRF violations, integrity mismatches, etc.).

settings_fields.label: Audit Log Retention (days)
settings_fields.description: Number of days to retain audit log entries before cleanup.

settings_fields.label: Enable Auto-Escalation
settings_fields.description: Automatically block IPs permanently when anti-spam blocks exceed the threshold.

settings_fields.label: Auto-Escalation Threshold
settings_fields.description: Number of anti-spam blocks within the window before permanent IP block.

settings_fields.label: Auto-Escalation Window (minutes)
settings_fields.description: Time window for counting anti-spam blocks towards auto-escalation.

events.description: File integrity check detected modified files
An IP was blocked by the admin allowlist
An IP was permanently blocked via auto-escalation
